# Andrés Pérez Coronado

> Founder & AI/ML Architect, FastAnalytics S.A.S. 20+ años construyendo modelos matemáticos y sistemas de IA para la seguridad ciudadana en Latinoamérica.

## Profile
- Name: Andrés Pérez Coronado
- Role: Founder & AI/ML Architect, FastAnalytics S.A.S.
- Website: https://andres-perez-coronado.fastanalytics.co
- Email: hola@fastanalytics.co
- Location: Colombia
- Languages: Spanish, English, French

## Education
- PhD in Mathematical Engineering — Universidad EAFIT (2025)
- MSc in Management — IAE, Université Grenoble Alpes
- Humphrey Fellow — University of Minnesota
- Fulbright Scholar

## Experience
- 20+ years in citizen security analytics; led teams of 80+ analysts within the Colombian National Police
- Founder & AI/ML Architect, FastAnalytics S.A.S. (2024–present)

## Upcoming
- Speaker, IACP 2026 Technology Conference — "Finding the Missing Links: Using AI to Map and Disrupt Transnational Crime Networks"

## Proven Results
- December 2021: Colombia's safest December in 19 years (-17% homicides nationwide, -33% Bogotá, 772 municipalities with zero homicides). Cuadrantes Outliers model, designed and deployed by Andrés Pérez Coronado
- 2024: Crime trend broken in Colombia (-17.8% robbery, -25.9% residential theft, -13% massacres, 7 of 11 crimes reduced in Bogotá). Multicrimen model, designed and deployed by Andrés Pérez Coronado

## Publications
- Research profile: https://independent.academia.edu/AndrésPérezCoronado (7+ academic papers)
- Book: "Policía para el Desarrollo Humano" (Grupo Editorial Ibáñez, 2021)
- Book (co-author, all chapters): "Analítica de datos para la seguridad ciudadana" (Editorial Logos, 2024)

## Selected Projects
- Cuadrantes Outliers — spatiotemporal outlier-detection model for homicide reduction, Colombia (2021)
- Multicrimen — multi-crime predictive model, Colombia (2024)
- AlejoSeguro — Telegram bot collecting georeferenced citizen security perceptions in Bogotá
- AlejoGeo — spatiotemporal intelligence platform (audio/text/video/image collection via chatbot)
- GabyVigía — predictive decision-making system (Watch · Predict · Decide)
- TavoDebate — multi-AI platform for legislative and regulatory sessions

## Affiliations
- Founder, FastAnalytics S.A.S. — https://fastanalytics.co (spatiotemporal AI for predictive decisions)
